_meta.note: Normalized for the ALP Classes auxiliary optional-feature loader. Rule text is concise/paraphrased; names, prerequisites, levels, and Replicate Magic Item tables follow the referenced 2014 5e.tools TCE Artificer Infusions filter.

optionalfeature.name: Arcane Propulsion Armor
optionalfeature.prerequisite-entry: 14th-level Artificer, a suit of armor (requires attunement)
entries: The infused armor increases the wearer's walking speed by 5 feet.
Its gauntlets become magic melee weapons that deal {@damage 1d8} force damage, have the thrown property (20/60 feet), and immediately return after being thrown.
The armor cannot be removed against the wearer's will and can functionally replace missing limbs.

optionalfeature.name: Armor of Magical Strength
entries: The armor has 6 charges. A wearer can spend 1 charge to add their Intelligence modifier to a Strength check or Strength saving throw.
If the wearer would be knocked {@condition prone}, they can use a reaction and spend 1 charge to remain standing.
The armor regains {@dice 1d6} expended charges daily at dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Boots of the Winding Path
optionalfeature.prerequisite-entry: 6th-level Artificer, a pair of boots (requires attunement)
entries: While wearing the boots, a creature can use a bonus action to teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, provided it occupied that space earlier in the current turn.

optionalfeature.name: Enhanced Arcane Focus
optionalfeature.prerequisite-entry: A rod, staff, or wand (requires attunement)
entries: While holding the focus, a creature gains a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls and ignores half cover when making spell attacks.
The bonus becomes +2 when the artificer reaches 10th level.

optionalfeature.name: Enhanced Defense
optionalfeature.prerequisite-entry: A suit of armor or a shield
entries: The infused armor or shield grants a +1 bonus to AC while worn or wielded.
The bonus becomes +2 when the artificer reaches 10th level.

optionalfeature.name: Enhanced Weapon
entries: The infused weapon grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls.
The bonus becomes +2 when the artificer reaches 10th level.

optionalfeature.name: Helm of Awareness
entries: While wearing the helm, a creature has advantage on initiative rolls and cannot be surprised unless it is {@condition incapacitated}.

optionalfeature.name: Homunculus Servant
optionalfeature.prerequisite-entry: A gem or crystal worth at least 100 gp
entries: The infused gem or crystal becomes the heart of a Tiny magical construct that serves the artificer. The artificer chooses its appearance.

The servant acts on the artificer's initiative immediately after them. It can move and use its reaction on its own, but normally takes the Dodge action unless the artificer uses a bonus action to command another action.
Its combat statistics scale with the artificer's level and proficiency bonus; it can make a ranged force attack and can deliver the artificer's touch-range spells by using its reaction.

optionalfeature.name: Mind Sharpener
optionalfeature.prerequisite-entry: A suit of armor or robes
entries: The infused item has 4 charges. When its wearer fails a Constitution saving throw to maintain {@status concentration} on a spell, the wearer can use a reaction and spend 1 charge to succeed instead.
The item regains {@dice 1d4} expended charges daily at dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Radiant Weapon
optionalfeature.prerequisite-entry: 6th-level Artificer, a simple or martial weapon (requires attunement)
entries: The infused weapon grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls.
As a bonus action, the wielder can make the weapon shed bright light for 30 feet and dim light for another 30 feet, or extinguish that light.

The weapon has 4 charges. After being hit by an attack, the wielder can use a reaction and spend 1 charge to force the attacker to make a Constitution saving throw against the artificer's spell save DC; on a failure, the attacker is {@condition blinded} until the end of its next turn. The weapon regains {@dice 1d4} charges daily at dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Repeating Shot
optionalfeature.prerequisite-entry: A simple or martial weapon with the ammunition property (requires attunement)
entries: When used for a ranged attack, the infused weapon grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls and ignores the loading property.
If no ammunition is loaded, the weapon creates its own piece of magical ammunition for each ranged attack; that ammunition disappears immediately after the attack resolves.

optionalfeature.name: Replicate Magic Item
entries: Choose a magic item the artificer is eligible to reproduce. This infusion can be learned multiple times, with a different eligible item chosen each time.
In addition to the listed options, the artificer can choose a common magic item, except a potion or spell scroll.

optionalfeature.name: Repulsion Shield
entries: The infused shield grants a +1 bonus to AC while wielded.

It has 4 charges. Immediately after being hit by a melee attack, the wielder can use a reaction and spend 1 charge to push the attacker up to 15 feet away. The shield regains {@dice 1d4} charges daily at dawn.

optionalfeature.name: Resistant Armor
optionalfeature.prerequisite-entry: 6th-level Artificer, a suit of armor (requires attunement)
entries: When the armor is infused, choose acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant, or thunder. A creature wearing the armor has resistance to the chosen damage type.

optionalfeature.name: Returning Weapon
optionalfeature.prerequisite-entry: A simple or martial weapon with the thrown property
entries: The infused weapon grants a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls and returns to the wielder's hand immediately after it is used to make a ranged attack.

optionalfeature.name: Spell-Refueling Ring
entries: While wearing the ring, a creature can use an action to recover one expended spell slot of 3rd level or lower. After the ring is used, it cannot be used again until the next dawn.
